scope: Auxiliary #43 owner module evidence; does not replace team engineering.json or individual.json.
decision: Use the published LocalWorkspace/PendingOperationStore ports, exclusive SQLite transactions for snapshot+queue and v1→v2 migration, and copy photos into private durable documents before publishing references.
alternatives: Memory + cache-only file references: simpler, but cannot survive process restart.
Separate durable JSON files/preferences: persists, but cannot atomically commit schema, snapshots and queue.
SQLite transactions plus durable private files, with copy cleanup on rollback: chosen.
tradeoff: Native dependencies and lifecycle/migration tests cost more than memory. SQL/FS are not jointly atomic: abrupt death can leave harmless unreferenced copies; no automatic photo garbage collection. Tokens remain in SecureStore. Confirmation and authorization policies remain the sync caller responsibility.
